# מסמך הגדרות המאגר (טיוטה)

> **טיוטה לבדיקה משפטית.** המסמך נכתב לעורך הדין לפי תקנות הגנת הפרטיות (אבטחת מידע), התשע״ז־2017, כפי שאנחנו מבינים
> את תקנה 2. עורך הדין יאשר שהסעיפים מכסים את מה שהתקנה דורשת, ויקבע איזו רמת אבטחה חלה. הפרטים בטבלאות נוצרים
> מהקוד (`worker/datamap.json`, `shared/retention.js`), ולכן הם תמיד תואמים את בסיס הנתונים. התיאורים של כל טבלה
> כתובים במילים של מפת המידע, באנגלית, כדי שאף אחד לא יספר אותם מחדש ביד.

נלווים לו שלוש טיוטות שנכתבו ביד: [נוהל אבטחת מידע](SECURITY_PROCEDURE.md), [תסקיר השפעה על הפרטיות](DPIA.md)
ו[תבנית הסכם עיבוד מידע עם בית ספר](SCHOOL_DPA.md). מפת המידע הקריאה: [DATA_MAP.md](DATA_MAP.md).

## 1. תיאור כללי של האיסוף והשימוש

מדרגות היא אפליקציה לתרגול מתמטיקה לכיתות ז׳ ו־ח׳. ההתקדמות של התלמיד נשמרת במכשיר שלו. השרת שומר מידע רק כשיש לו
סיבה: תלמיד בכיתה (כדי שהמורה יראה את התרגול), הורה או מורה שנכנסים במייל, תשלום, גיבוי מוצפן, ומונים שמגבילים
שימוש. בבסיס הנתונים יש 48 טבלאות: 12 עם מידע אישי,
23 בכינוי בלבד ו־13 בלי מידע על אדם.

## 3. סוגי המידע

- **אישי** (names a person (a name, an email address, words a person wrote) or points at a row that does): `accounts`, `assignment_work`, `assignments`, `attempts`, `classes`, `exams`, `help_messages`, `help_requests`, `levels`, `licence_requests`, `students`, `waitlist`.
- **בכינוי (פסאודונימי)** (only a random id or a keyed hash; it points at a person only together with another table or a secret the server holds): `account_sessions`, `ai_spend`, `ai_usage`, `assignment_targets`, `audit_log`, `class_owners`, `class_steps`, `family_daily`, `family_devices`, `help_meta`, `link_codes`, `login_codes`, `notices`, `orders`, `payments`, `push_subs`, `refund_queue`, `student_ai_off`, `student_tokens`, `subscriptions`, `vault_escrow`, `vault_tombstones`, `vaults`.
- **לא אישי** (cannot point at a person): `ai_quality`, `answer_reports`, `billing_events`, `class_goal_settings`, `class_goal_weeks`, `class_locks`, `class_settings`, `client_errors`, `licence_codes`, `meters`, `metrics_daily`, `order_renewals`, `safety_events`.

## 4. מקורות המידע

| על מי | מאיפה המידע מגיע |
|---|---|
| תלמידים | התלמיד, דרך האפליקציה (שם שהוא בוחר כשהוא מצטרף לכיתה, תשובות, בקשות עזרה). שום דבר לא נאסף ממקור חיצוני. |
| הורים | ההורה, דרך עמוד ההורים (כתובת מייל בכניסה, בחירת מסלול, מכשירים שקישר), וחברת הסליקה (אישור התשלום). |
| מורים | המורה, דרך האפליקציה (כתובת מייל בכניסה, שם הכיתה, מטלות, הגדרות הכיתה). |
| מכשירים | האפליקציה במכשיר, שיוצרת מספרים אקראיים לזיהוי ההתקנה והגיבוי. בלי מזהה של יצרן או של חנות. |
| רשתות (כתובת IP מגובבת) | הבקשה עצמה: השרת מגבב את כתובת הרשת עם מפתח סודי ושומר רק את הגיבוב, לספירת מגבלות. |
| אף אחד | השרת עצמו (ספירות, מצב, שגיאות בלי תוכן). |

## 5. מחזיקים ומי שמקבל מידע

| מי | תפקיד | איפה | מה הוא מקבל (מתוך מפת המידע) | טבלאות |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cloudflare | מחזיק: מריץ את השרת ושומר את בסיס הנתונים (D1) | באיחוד האירופי כשבסיס הנתונים נוצר עם --jurisdiction=eu (DB_JURISDICTION = "eu") | Cloudflare runs the Worker and keeps the D1 database: in the EU once it was created with --jurisdiction=eu (setup.ps1, DB_JURISDICTION = "eu"). Invocation logs are off (wrangler.toml), so request headers and bodies are not logged; our own console lines and errors are kept 3-7 days and hold no request contents (test/logs.test.js). | `account_sessions`, `accounts`, `ai_quality`, `ai_spend`, `ai_usage`, `answer_reports`, `assignment_targets`, `assignment_work`, `assignments`, `attempts`, `audit_log`, `billing_events`, `class_goal_settings`, `class_goal_weeks`, `class_locks`, `class_owners`, `class_settings`, `class_steps`, `classes`, `client_errors`, `exams`, `family_daily`, `family_devices`, `help_messages`, `help_meta`, `help_requests`, `levels`, `licence_codes`, `licence_requests`, `link_codes`, `login_codes`, `meters`, `metrics_daily`, `notices`, `order_renewals`, `orders`, `payments`, `push_subs`, `refund_queue`, `safety_events`, `student_ai_off`, `student_tokens`, `students`, `subscriptions`, `vault_escrow`, `vault_tombstones`, `vaults`, `waitlist` |
| Resend | מחזיק: שולח את המיילים של השירות | ארה״ב | Resend (in the US) sends the service emails: the recipient's address and the email itself (a sign-in code, a receipt or notice with dates, amounts and a device label), and the waitlist's one launch email (the address, the store links and its removal link). | `accounts`, `licence_requests`, `notices`, `waitlist` |
| חברת הסליקה | מחזיק: גובה תשלום ומפיקה חשבונית | לפי החברה שתיבחר: Grow, שהקוד מוכן אליה, היא חברה ישראלית; אחרת ______ | The payment company receives the payer's email address, the order id, the plan and the amount; card details are typed only on its page and never reach us. | `accounts`, `orders`, `payments`, `refund_queue`, `subscriptions` |
| Anthropic | מחזיק: מריץ את העוזר החכם, בקשה אחר בקשה | ארה״ב | Anthropic (in the US) runs the tutor. It receives what the "ai" block lists, per request; nothing of it is kept in these tables. | אף טבלה: רק מה שבסעיף 11 |
| שירות ההתראות של הדפדפן | מעביר תזכורת יומית מוצפנת למכשיר שביקש אותה | לפי הדפדפן (Google, Apple, Mozilla או Microsoft) | The browser's push service (Google, Apple, Mozilla or Microsoft, chosen by the browser) carries the daily reminder to a device that turned it on (STUDENT-11): it receives the push address it gave the browser and the reminder, encrypted end to end (RFC 8291), with no name, class or account. | `push_subs` |

צריך הסכם עיבוד מידע חתום עם כל מחזיק (צעד של הבעלים, `docs/legal/LAWYER_PACKET.md` §3).

## 6. העברה אל מחוץ לישראל

- **Cloudflare**: באיחוד האירופי כשבסיס הנתונים נוצר עם --jurisdiction=eu (DB_JURISDICTION = "eu"). המטרה: מריץ את השרת ושומר את בסיס הנתונים (D1).
- **Resend**: ארה״ב. המטרה: שולח את המיילים של השירות.
- **חברת הסליקה**: לפי החברה שתיבחר: Grow, שהקוד מוכן אליה, היא חברה ישראלית; אחרת ______. המטרה: גובה תשלום ומפיקה חשבונית.
- **Anthropic**: ארה״ב. המטרה: מריץ את העוזר החכם, בקשה אחר בקשה.
- **שירות ההתראות של הדפדפן**: לפי הדפדפן (Google, Apple, Mozilla או Microsoft). המטרה: מעביר תזכורת יומית מוצפנת למכשיר שביקש אותה.

לעורך הדין: על איזה בסיס בתקנות הגנת הפרטיות (העברת מידע אל מאגרי מידע שמחוץ לגבולות המדינה), התשס״א־2001, ההעברות
האלה מותרות, ומה צריך להופיע בהסכמים.

## 7. מי ניגש למידע

- **בעל השליטה בלבד** ניגש לחשבון Cloudflare, לבסיס הנתונים ולסודות של השרת. רשימת בעלי ההרשאות: ______.
- **מורה** רואה באפליקציה רק את התלמידים של הכיתות שלו, אחרי שנכנס עם מפתח המורה או עם המייל שלו.
- **הורה** רואה רק את המנוי, התשלומים והמכשירים של המשפחה שלו, אחרי כניסה במייל.
- **תלמיד** רואה רק את מה שבמכשיר שלו.
- **המחזיקים** בסעיף 5 מקבלים רק את מה שכתוב שם.

## 8. תקופות השמירה

המספרים האלה הם אלה שהמחיקה הלילית (`worker/src/cron.js`) משתמשת בהם. ההסבר בכל שורה הוא ההערה שבקוד.

| שם בקוד | כמה זמן | למה (מתוך `shared/retention.js`) |
|---|---|---|
| `classIdleDays` | 400 ימים | a class with no activity (teacher or student) for this long and no running licence is deleted |
| `studentIdleDays` | 400 ימים | a class student nobody has seen for this long is deleted with everything they have on the server |
| `attemptsDays` | 400 ימים | a class student's practice answers on the server; older ones are not accepted from a device either |
| `examsDays` | 400 ימים | exam results kept for the class, counted from the upload |
| `assignmentsDays` | 400 ימים | a teacher's assignment, with what each student did on it, counted from its due date (TEACHER-4) |
| `helpImageAfterDoneDays` | 30 ימים | a help request's notebook page, after the teacher closes the request |
| `helpImageMaxDays` | 60 ימים | ... and at most this long after it was sent, closed or not |
| `helpAfterDoneDays` | 180 ימים | a help request itself, after the teacher closes it |
| `helpMaxDays` | 365 ימים | ... and at most this long after it was sent |
| `accountIdleDays` | 730 ימים | a parent or teacher account with no sign-in and nothing live |
| `safetyEventsDays` | 400 ימים | safety_events rows (counts only: no person, no text) |
| `answerReportsDays` | 60 ימים | a reported AI answer (the tutor's text only) |
| `licenceRequestAfterHandledDays` | 730 ימים | a class licence request, after the owner handled it |
| `licenceCodeAfterExpiryDays` | 365 ימים | a licence code, after it expired |
| `claimCodeDays` | 7 ימים | the one-time code a teacher's PIN reset gives the student (COUNCIL2-25): it stops working then, and is cleared |
| `taxYears` | 7 שנים | money records: kept to the end of the 7th calendar year after their tax year |
| `noticesDays` | 90 ימים | an email notice, after it was sent (or gave up after its tries) |
| `unpaidOrderDays` | 30 ימים | an order that expired unpaid, after it was made |
| `auditLogDays` | 730 ימים | the audit log of actions on money and access |
| `billingEventsDays` | 2557 ימים | a payment company's event, after it arrived (7 years) |
| `aiUsageDays` | 35 ימים | daily and hourly counters (the tutor's questions, the codes of devices and networks) |
| `aiUsageMonths` | 13 ימים | monthly counters |
| `aiQualityDays` | 400 ימים | the tutor's quality counts (ai_quality, AI-3) |
| `aiSpendDays` | 400 ימים | what the tutor cost, per pool and day or month (ai_spend) |
| `classStepsDays` | 120 ימים | a class student's step toward the class goal (class_steps, STUDENT-4) |
| `classGoalWeeksDays` | 400 ימים | a class goal's week (class_goal_weeks, STUDENT-4) |
| `metricsDays` | 400 ימים | reach counts with no identity (metrics_daily, STUDENT-14) |
| `clientErrorsDays` | 30 ימים | the app's error reports (client_errors), counted from their day |
| `familyDailyDays` | 90 ימים | a linked device's daily summary for the parents (family_daily): the last 90 days, today included |
| `vaultIdleDays` | 400 ימים | an encrypted backup with no write and no read; a deleted backup's tombstone as long |
| `studentTokenIdleDays` | 400 ימים | a class student's device token nobody used |
| `familyDeviceIdleDays` | 365 ימים | a family device nobody used: unlinked and deleted |
| `familyLinkDays` | 1 ימים | a family link code after it expired, and a device row that never collected its token |
| `sessionIdleDays` | 180 ימים | a parent's or teacher's sign-in nobody used (it stops working, and goes) |
| `pushIdleDays` | 45 ימים | a daily reminder whose app was not opened (or, never opened, after it was made) |
| `waitlistAfterLaunchDays` | 30 ימים | every signup, once this long has passed since the owner marked the launch (WAITLIST_LAUNCHED_AT) |
| `waitlistMaxDays` | 365 ימים | a signup this long after it was made, launched or not (about 12 months) |

## 9. כל טבלה ועמודותיה

### `account_sessions`

- **סוג:** בכינוי (פסאודונימי). **על מי:** הורים, מורים.
- **עמודות:** `token_hash`, `account_id`, `created_at`, `last_seen`, `verified_at`.
- **מטרה:** A signed-in browser of a parent or teacher: the hash of its token.
- **שמירה:** Until signing out, 180 days unused (RETENTION.sessionIdleDays), or the account is deleted.
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.purgeAccountsSql`, `forget.forgetAccount`.

### `accounts`

- **סוג:** אישי. **על מי:** הורים, מורים.
- **עמודות:** `id`, `email`, `created_at`, `last_seen`, `adult_confirmed_at`, `terms_version`, `billing_hold_at`, `report_email_at`.
- **מטרה:** A parent or a teacher who signs in by email: the address (to sign in, and for receipts and notices), the day last seen, the 18+ declaration (adult_confirmed_at: the 18+ tick at checkout, or a teacher's "I am over 18, a teacher or a tutor" at sign-in or when binding a class, COUNCIL2-5; without it a class bound to the email has no adult behind it, so its student AI cannot be turned on), the terms accepted at checkout, and a hold after a chargeback. report_email_at: when the parents' weekly report email last went to this address (PARENTS-7).
- **שמירה:** Until the account is deleted (the parents' page, or the owner on request), or 730 days with no sign-in and nothing running (RETENTION.accountIdleDays).
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare, Resend, חברת הסליקה.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.purgeLongTerm`, `forget.forgetAccount`.

### `ai_quality`

- **סוג:** לא אישי. **על מי:** אף אחד.
- **עמודות:** `day`, `kind`, `reason`, `n`.
- **מטרה:** How the tutor's answers fared, as counts per day (an answer masked, an empty reply, a generated exercise dropped). No person, device or text.
- **שמירה:** 400 days (RETENTION.aiQualityDays).
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.purgeCountersSql`.

### `ai_spend`

- **סוג:** בכינוי (פסאודונימי). **על מי:** הורים, מורים, אף אחד.
- **עמודות:** `pool`, `period`, `calls`, `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cache_tokens`, `nano_usd`.
- **מטרה:** What the tutor cost, per pool (a family account id, a class code, a shared pool, or in the open tier a class's or a teacher account's own part of the day) and day or month, to keep the budget caps.
- **שמירה:** 400 days after its day or month (RETENTION.aiSpendDays).
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.purgeRecordsSql`.

### `ai_usage`

- **סוג:** בכינוי (פסאודונימי). **על מי:** תלמידים, הורים, מורים, מכשירים, רשתות (כתובת IP מגובבת).
- **עמודות:** `who`, `day`, `count`.
- **מטרה:** Counters that keep the limits: questions to the tutor, sign-in codes, joins and new names, shared assignment links opened, PIN tries (per network and per student a day), care messages, one safety alert a day, reported answers and the day's writes of a class student, of their class and of their network, per student id, family device id, account id, class code, or keyed hash of the install id (devKey) or of the network address (netKey); the mark that a student signed in from a network (joined:s:<student>:<keyed hash of the network>), so that other people's wrong PINs cannot lock the student out there; and the dollars the free and open pools, and a class's or an email's part of the open pool, hold for requests in flight (usd:<pool>). Never a raw device id or address.
- **שמירה:** Daily and hourly counters 35 days, monthly ones 13 months (RETENTION.aiUsageDays, RETENTION.aiUsageMonths); a student's, family device's or install's counters at once when it deletes all, and a student's or class's when the teacher removes or deletes them.
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.purgeCountersSql`, `forget.studentCountersStmt`, `forget.familyDeviceCountersStmt`, `forget.deviceCountersStmt`, `forget.classDeleteSteps`.

### `answer_reports`

- **סוג:** לא אישי. **על מי:** אף אחד.
- **עמודות:** `id`, `created_at`, `reason`, `kind`, `reply`, `tier`.
- **מטרה:** A tutor answer a child reported: why, where, and the tutor's own text with personal details masked. Never the child's message, never who sent it.
- **שמירה:** 60 days (RETENTION.answerReportsDays).
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.purgeSafetySql`.

### `assignment_targets`

- **סוג:** בכינוי (פסאודונימי). **על מי:** תלמידים.
- **עמודות:** `assignment_id`, `student_id`.
- **מטרה:** The students an assignment is for, when it is not for the whole class.
- **שמירה:** With its assignment or the student.
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.purgeClassSteps`, `forget.studentDeleteStmts`, `forget.studentsDeleteSteps`, `forget.classDeleteSteps`.

### `assignment_work`

- **סוג:** אישי. **על מי:** תלמידים.
- **עמודות:** `assignment_id`, `student_id`, `state`, `stage`, `right_n`, `asked`, `passed`, `questions`, `tries`, `started_at`, `done_at`, `done_day`, `updated_at`.
- **מטרה:** What a student did on an assignment, worked out on the student's device: started or done, stages done, how many right of how many, the check passed, an exam's questions as topic, stair and status, tries and dates.
- **שמירה:** With its assignment (400 days after the due date: RETENTION.assignmentsDays) or the student.
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.purgeClassSteps`, `forget.studentDeleteStmts`, `forget.studentsDeleteSteps`, `forget.classDeleteSteps`.

### `assignments`

- **סוג:** אישי. **על מי:** מורים.
- **עמודות:** `id`, `class_code`, `kind`, `skill`, `title`, `note`, `exam`, `version`, `for_all`, `starts_on`, `due_on`, `created_at`, `misc`.
- **מטרה:** Work a teacher gives the class or chosen students (TEACHER-4): a stair, a check, a class exam (its frozen questions) or the repair of one mistake on a stair (misc: the app's id of that mistake, SK-BUYERS-2), with the teacher's title and short note and the dates.
- **שמירה:** 400 days after its due date (RETENTION.assignmentsDays); with the class.
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare.

### `subscriptions`

- **סוג:** בכינוי (פסאודונימי). **על מי:** הורים, מורים.
- **עמודות:** `id`, `kind`, `account_id`, `class_code`, `plan`, `status`, `provider`, `provider_subscription_id`, `price_agorot`, `seats`, `invoice_ref`, `current_period_start`, `current_period_end`, `cancel_at_period_end`, `cancel_requested_at`, `cancel_synced_at`, `first_paid_at`, `refund_until`, `ended_reason`, `last_event_at`, `note`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.
- **מטרה:** A family plan (monthly, one-year, or the 30-day exam pass, which is paid once and never renews) or a class licence: its dates, price, cancellation and refund window. It loses its account id when the account is deleted.
- **שמירה:** While it runs; an ended plan is a money record: to the end of the 7th calendar year after its tax year (RETENTION.taxYears), and longer while a kept payment, refund or renewal still points at it.
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare, חברת הסליקה.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.purgeLongTermSql`.

### `vault_escrow`

- **סוג:** בכינוי (פסאודונימי). **על מי:** תלמידים, הורים, מכשירים.
- **עמודות:** `id`, `vault_id`, `owner_kind`, `owner_id`, `device_id`, `label`, `sealed`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.
- **מטרה:** A backup's restore code sealed with a Worker secret (DURABLE-6), kept for an identity the user already has: a class student (back with the PIN) or a family account (a new linked device), with the device it came from and an optional label the parent chose. Never shown to a teacher or a parent.
- **שמירה:** With the student, the account or the vault. A family device's copy goes when the device leaves by itself or deletes all, and on the parent's unlink while the child's sharing switch is off; a parent's unlink with the switch on keeps it in the account without the device id.
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.purgeIdentitySql`, `cron.vaultNight`, `forget.studentDeleteStmts`, `forget.studentsDeleteSteps`, `forget.familyDeviceDeleteStmts`, `forget.forgetAccount`.

### `vault_tombstones`

- **סוג:** בכינוי (פסאודונימי). **על מי:** תלמידים, מכשירים.
- **עמודות:** `id_hash`, `deleted_at`.
- **מטרה:** A backup its owner deleted (stop the backup, or delete all; DURABLE-5, migration 0008_vault_guard): only the hash the vault was stored under and when it was deleted, so another device that still has the same restore code is told the backup was deleted (410 vault_deleted) instead of making it again. No content, no code, no address.
- **שמירה:** 400 days after the deletion, as long as an unused vault is kept (RETENTION.vaultIdleDays, the vaults' night); a vault that expired leaves none.
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.vaultNight`.

### `vaults`

- **סוג:** בכינוי (פסאודונימי). **על מי:** תלמידים, מכשירים.
- **עמודות:** `id_hash`, `rev`, `blob`, `prev_rev`, `prev_blob`, `bytes`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `read_at`.
- **מטרה:** The encrypted backup of a device's practice (DURABLE-5): ciphertext only, found by the SHA-256 of a lookup token the device derives from its restore code. For a solo student it is on by default once the app has a server (COUNCIL2-24): made right after the first questions, and stopped in Settings (stop the backup). The restore code stays on the device: the key and the code never reach the server, so nobody here can open it (unless a class or a family keeps the code: vault_escrow); the previous version is kept for one step back.
- **שמירה:** 400 days with no write and no read (RETENTION.vaultIdleDays); at once when the device stops the backup or deletes all (the app deletes it before anything local).
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.vaultNight`.

### `waitlist`

- **סוג:** אישי. **על מי:** הורים, מורים.
- **עמודות:** `id`, `email`, `role`, `grade`, `platform`, `source`, `consent_at`, `created_at`, `sent_at`, `tries`.
- **מטרה:** The waitlist for the store apps (src/waitlist.js, the public page /waitlist/ and /w/): an email address of a parent or a teacher (no student is asked for an email) that asked for one email when the iPhone and Android apps are in the stores, who is asking (parent or teacher: the signup is an adult's, and the list is counted by audience), the grade and the phone if given (counts for the owner), and a short label of the ad that brought them (utm_source/utm_campaign), so the owner can see whether enough people want the apps and write to them once. consent_at: when the box asking for that one email was ticked, required to join. sent_at and tries: the one launch email, which the Worker sends itself through Resend from the launch day (one message per address, marked as an advertisement, with the advertiser's details and a removal link). No name, network address, device or free text; the signup limits count a keyed code of the network in ai_usage (35 days). No signup is taken while CONTACT_EMAIL or BUSINESS_NAME is empty. The owner reads counts only (npm run owner -- waitlist), and may export the record of consent (waitlist --export, a file to delete after use).
- **שמירה:** 30 days after the launch day the owner sets (WAITLIST_LAUNCHED_AT, RETENTION.waitlistAfterLaunchDays), and at the latest 365 days after the signup (RETENTION.waitlistMaxDays), whichever comes first. Earlier on request (npm run owner -- waitlist --remove, or forget --email), by the launch email's removal link (POST /api/waitlist/leave), and with an account of the same email when it is deleted.
- **עובר אל:** Cloudflare, Resend.
- **נמחק על ידי:** `cron.purgeRecordsSql`, `forget.forgetAccount`.

## 10. מה נשמר במכשיר

המכשיר הוא לא חלק מהמאגר בשרת, אבל המפתחות שהאפליקציה שומרת בו כתובים כאן כדי שהתמונה תהיה שלמה.

| מפתח | איפה | סוג | מה יש בו |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<STORE_KEY>` | localStorage | אישי | The student's saved state: the name, grade and (in a class) the class code and name, the teacher's name, the class token and student id; progress, days, XP, mistakes, the learning model, checked exam summaries and practice exams; a family challenge accepted from a parent's link, or sent from this device (a goal and its week, no name); the tutor's settings (server address, the install id sent as X-Device, the family-device token and its label, a pending link code, the plan the server reported last, whether the introduction was read; a personal key only in the owner's own dev build); answers waiting to be sent to the class; the backup's settings, with the restore code and its lookup token while the backup is on (on by default for a solo student once there is a server, COUNCIL2-24): the code stays here, and the server gets only the lookup token (stored as its hash) and the encrypted copy. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-parent` | localStorage or sessionStorage | אישי | The parent's or teacher's session token and email address. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-checkout-*` | sessionStorage | לא אישי | A random key per plan for one checkout attempt. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-order` | sessionStorage | בכינוי (פסאודונימי) | The id of the order being paid. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-link-code` | sessionStorage | בכינוי (פסאודונימי) | A child's device link code (from its QR code) waiting to be claimed. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-here` | sessionStorage | לא אישי | A flag: the parents' page was opened on the child's own device. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-adult` | sessionStorage | לא אישי | A flag: the adult step before the parents' area was passed in this tab. Never the year typed. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-adult-wait` | localStorage | לא אישי | A time, at most 10 minutes ahead, until which the adult step stays closed after a year that is not an adult's. Never the year. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-photo-warned` | sessionStorage | לא אישי | A flag: the warning before exam, notebook and test-material photos was read in this session. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-theme` | localStorage | לא אישי | The look chosen on this device: light, dark or following the phone (the student lane's lib/theme.js), mirrored for public/theme-boot.js so the first paint has the right colours. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-src` | localStorage | לא אישי | 'play' when the app was opened from the Play Store app (?src=play), and nothing else (the student lane's lib/install.js). |
| `<STORE_KEY>-report-fb-week` | localStorage | לא אישי | The Sunday of the week the parent last answered "הסיכום עוזר לכם?" on /parents in this browser (the family lane's FamilyReport.jsx), and nothing else. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-demo` | sessionStorage | לא אישי | A flag: this tab shows the teacher's demo class (the school lane's lib/demo.js), whose made-up class and students are never saved. |
| `<STORE_KEY>-preview-back` | sessionStorage | לא אישי | Where a teacher's preview of a student screen leads back to: a /teacher address of the app (lib/teacher.js). |
| `<STORE_KEY>-durable` | indexedDB | אישי | A database in the browser with a copy of the saved state and the saves it could not read (the durable lane's lib/durable/storage.js and idb.js): the same data as <STORE_KEY>. |
| `madregot-debug` | localStorage | לא אישי | A flag set by hand on a test device. |
| `madregot-seed` | localStorage | לא אישי | A number set by hand on a test device. |
| `madregot-push` | indexedDB | בכינוי (פסאודונימי) | The daily reminder's id and secret on this device (database madregot-push, store 'sub', key 'current'), which the service worker reads to report an opened reminder and to renew a changed push subscription. |
| `madregot-reloaded` | sessionStorage | לא אישי | When the page was last reloaded after a part of the app failed to load (a new release replaced it), as a time and nothing else (lib/monitor.js RELOAD_KEY, DURABLE-9). |
| `madregot-*` | sessionStorage or cache | לא אישי | The mocked state a QA link chose (madregot-qa-ai, madregot-qa-parent, madregot-qa-teacher, madregot-qa-report), on QA builds only; and, in the browser's Cache Storage, the service worker's copy of the app's own files for each release (madregot-<release>: code, styles, icons; nothing of the user). |
| `__t` | localStorage | לא אישי | A probe value, removed at once. |

## 11. מה העוזר החכם מקבל

- The context of the exercise the student asks about: the stair and its name, the exercise, the app's answer and solution, the answers the student typed in this exercise, the names of the mistakes the app found, the stair's explanations, and the counts of the learning summary.
- The messages the student writes in the chat, the question written beside a photo, and an explanation the student chose to send for feedback, after the server masks email addresses, phone numbers and ID numbers.
- For new exercises: the exercises the app chose with their answers, the topic and stair names, and the grade. Nothing the student wrote.
- Photos (a notebook page, a photographed solution, exam pages, and up to four pictures of a coming test's material sent with the grade's list of stairs by the app's own names), only after the device's photo step: cropped (the top 15% of an exam's first page by default), blacked out where the child chose, and re-encoded as JPEG, so no camera data (EXIF) leaves the device. A PDF is opened on the device and each of its pages goes through the same step as a photo; the PDF file itself is never sent.

**לא נשלח אף פעם:** A name, a class or class code, the device id or its token, an email address, dates, a teacher's message pasted into Exam Rescue (it is read on the device), or any other text the student wrote in the app (web/src/lib/tutorContext.test.js fails on a context field that is not on the list).

**מה נשמר אצלנו:** Nothing of a conversation or a photo. Safety events are counts with no text (safety_events); a reported answer keeps the tutor's text only (answer_reports).

**מה נשמר אצל Anthropic:** API inputs and outputs are deleted within 30 days by default, unless kept longer to enforce its usage policy or by law; zero data retention is available on request (an owner step, TRUST-15). No training on API data by default.
